notes: Cognitive walkthrough (full four-question variant) of journey change-slot at 375 px, light theme. Record: cw/change-slot.json. No source, builder notes, detector output or other evaluators' files were read.

task_suitability.evidence: probes/7: final URL /confirm.html, slot 14:20 to 14:40, day Saturday 17 October

strengths.title: Changing the slot returns straight to Check and book with vehicle, waste and typed details kept, so the resident does not redo steps 2 and 3
'Change slot' sits on the slot row of the booking summary, in view at 375 px, in the residents' own word

candidates.title: Change slot opens the When page reset to Today, with no sign that an existing booking is being changed
candidates.description: When a resident changes one part of a booking, the page they land on should show the current choice and make clear the rest is kept. Activating 'Change slot' on Check and book opens /index.html headed 'Book a slot', with step '1. When' current, the 'Today' day button pressed, an empty Slots area, and no mention of the booking in progress: Saturday 17 and 09:20 are not preselected, and nothing says the vehicle, waste or entered details are kept (they are, as shown on return). The resident has to re-pick the day they already chose.
candidates.impact: Residents changing a booking, who do not know whether changing keeps the rest, may think they have started a new booking and abandon or go back; they may also not notice the day was reset and read the empty slot area under 'Today' as no slots or still loading.

scope.persona: resident changing a slot mid-booking on a phone
scope.task: move the slot to 14:20 the same day

evidence.detail: click Change slot -> /index.html; heading 'Book a slot'; button 'Today' [pressed]; Saturday 17 not pressed; Slots group empty
registration and name typed before changing are still present after returning; nothing on the When page announced this

factor_notes.frequency: Every slot change from the confirm page.
factor_notes.impact: Steps 1 and 2 of change-slot judged would_with_effort; the resident must re-choose the day and trust that the rest is kept.
factor_notes.persistence: Recurs on each change; a returning resident may learn it.

candidates.recommendation: When arriving from Change slot, preselect the booked day and slot, and say that the vehicle, waste and details are kept (for example a line naming the current booking and a button that returns to Check and book).

candidates.title: 'Few left' slots are shown out of time order above the Morning heading, splitting the afternoon list
candidates.description: A slot list should read in time order within its Morning and Afternoon groups, so a resident can scan for a time. On the When page for Saturday 17, the ten 'Few left' slots (08:20 ... 13:40, 14:00, 15:00, 16:40) are shown in a block above the 'Morning' heading, while the accessibility tree lists them in time order inside Morning and Afternoon. In the visual block 14:00 is directly followed by 15:00, and the 'Afternoon' group omits 13:40, 14:00, 15:00 and 16:40, so 14:20 appears only further down.
candidates.impact: A resident scanning from the top for a particular time may conclude it is not available when it is listed lower down; keyboard and screen-reader users meet the slots in a different order from what is seen.

scope.persona: resident changing a slot mid-booking on a phone
scope.task: move the slot to 14:20 the same day

evidence.detail: Few-left block above 'Morning'; Afternoon group lacks 13:40, 14:00, 15:00, 16:40
group 'Slots' lists Morning 08:00-11:40 and Afternoon 12:00-17:20 in time order, Few-left slots included

factor_notes.frequency: Every day that has 'Few left' slots; seen on the main slot-picking step of both booking and changing.
factor_notes.impact: Step 3 of change-slot judged would_with_effort; the wanted time is present but not where time order puts it.
factor_notes.persistence: Order changes as availability changes, so it is not learnable.

candidates.recommendation: Keep every slot in time order within Morning and Afternoon and show 'Few left' as a tag on the slot in place.
